content.value_statement: Manual Drive uploads interrupt automated workflows and require repeated metadata choices. This skill uploads local files with automatic MIME detection and optional destination settings.
actual_capabilities: Uploads one local file to Google Drive through the gws CLI.
Detects the file MIME type automatically.
Uses the local filename when no target name is supplied.
Places the uploaded file in a specified Drive folder.
Assigns a custom filename to the uploaded Drive file.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and its generated shared authentication instructions.
Handles a single local file per documented command.
Does not document recursive folder uploads or batch processing.
Performs a write operation and requires user confirmation before execution.

use_cases.title: Publish a Team Report
use_cases.description: Upload a finished report into a selected shared Drive folder with its original filename.

use_cases.title: Archive Exported Data
use_cases.description: Store a local CSV export in Drive under a clear destination filename.

use_cases.title: Deliver Generated Documents
use_cases.description: Place generated files in a designated Drive folder after confirming the write operation.

prompt_templates.title: Upload One File
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [local file path] to Google Drive. Show the planned action and ask for confirmation before executing.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs to upload one file with default metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Upload to a Folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [local file path] to the Drive folder with ID [folder ID]. Confirm the source and destination first.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants to place a file in a specific folder.

prompt_templates.title: Rename During Upload
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [local file path] to Google Drive as [target filename]. Ask for confirmation before running the write command.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs a different filename in Drive.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Controlled Upload
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify [local file path], destination folder [folder ID], and target name [filename]. Summarize the upload, then execute only after explicit confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced workflow requires all upload settings and a confirmation checkpoint.

output_examples.input: Upload report.pdf to the quarterly reports folder.
output_examples.output: Ready to upload report.pdf to the specified Drive folder. Confirmation is required before the write operation.

output_examples.input: Upload data.csv and name it Sales Data.csv.
Upload notes.txt using its current name.
output_examples.output: The upload will use notes.txt as the Drive filename after you confirm the operation.

best_practices: Verify the local file path before preparing the upload.
Confirm the destination folder ID and target filename with the user.
Request explicit confirmation immediately before executing the write command.
anti_patterns: Do not upload sensitive files without verifying the intended destination.
Do not invent a folder ID or filename when the request is ambiguous.
Do not execute the upload before the user confirms the write operation.

faq.question: What software does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the gws CLI and the generated shared skill instructions for authentication and security rules.

faq.question: How is the MIME type selected?
faq.answer: The upload command detects the MIME type automatically from the local file.

faq.question: Can I choose a destination folder?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the target Google Drive folder ID with the parent option.

faq.question: Can I rename the file during upload?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a target filename; otherwise, the local filename is used.

faq.question: Does the skill upload folders?
faq.answer: No folder upload workflow is documented. The command accepts one local file path.

faq.question: Does the skill ask before uploading?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions require explicit user confirmation because uploading is a write operation.
